name: tts
description: Reads Claude's replies aloud as they stream, sentence by sentence, through VOICEVOX, Irodori-TTS or any command.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Read replies aloud. /tts on and /tts off set this.

mode.title: Read mode
mode.description: stream: every sentence as the reply streams. final: only the turn's final answer, once it ends. notify: only short notices (done, error, a question or plan waiting for you).

engine.title: TTS engine
engine.description: voicevox: VOICEVOX or a compatible engine (AivisSpeech, COEIROINK v1). irodori: Irodori-TTS (/v1/audio/speech). command: the command below.

fallback.title: Fallback engine
fallback.description: Tried for a sentence the engine above fails (its server down, a setting unset). none: report the error and skip the sentence.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Speech speed multiplier (Irodori: 0.25–4, VOICEVOX: speedScale). The mod does not enforce Irodori's lower limit; its server may reject values outside that range. engine=command ignores it.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Playback volume multiplier for every engine (1: as synthesized, 0.5: half, 2: double). Applied by the player; aplay and powershell need ffmpeg for it.

player.title: Player
player.description: How a wav is played. auto: ffplay then powershell.exe on native Windows; ffplay, paplay, aplay, afplay, powershell.exe elsewhere.

maxCharsPerTurn.title: Max characters per response
maxCharsPerTurn.description: Maximum characters read from one model response, excluding the cut notice; text before a tool call and the answer after it count apart. 0 reads everything.

interruptOnPrompt.title: Stop on new prompt
interruptOnPrompt.description: Stop speaking when you submit a new prompt.

modelPrompt.title: Prompt for the model
modelPrompt.description: Added to Claude's system prompt while replies are read (stream and final modes), so that what is spoken reads well. Empty: add nothing.
modelPrompt.default: 応答は音声で読み上げられています。説明やツール呼び出しの合間の進捗報告は原則として日本語で書いてください。ただし、コード・識別子・引用はそのまま保持し、ユーザーが指定した言語を優先してください。

irodoriVoice.title: Irodori voice
irodoriVoice.description: Reference voice id registered on the Irodori server.

voicevoxSpeaker.title: VOICEVOX speaker
voicevoxSpeaker.description: Style id passed as speaker (3: ずんだもん ノーマル).

command.title: Command (engine=command)
command.description: For engine=command: argv split on spaces, {out} replaced by the wav path to write; the text arrives on stdin.

noticeDone.title: Notice: done
noticeDone.description: Said in notify mode as a turn ends with an answer. Empty: say nothing.

noticeError.title: Notice: error
noticeError.description: Said in notify mode as an API error ends a turn. Empty: say nothing.
noticeError.default: エラーで止まりました。

noticeRefusal.title: Notice: refusal
noticeRefusal.description: Said in notify mode as the model refuses. Empty: say nothing.
noticeRefusal.default: 応答できませんでした。

noticeQuestion.title: Notice: question
noticeQuestion.description: Said as a question opens, before the question itself. Empty: silence both the notice and the question.

noticeQuestions.title: Notice: questions
noticeQuestions.description: Said as several questions open, in place of reading them; {n} is their number. Empty: say nothing.

noticePlan.title: Notice: plan
noticePlan.description: Said as a plan waits for approval. Empty: say nothing.
noticePlan.default: プランの確認をお願いします。

noticeCommand.title: Notice: command
noticeCommand.description: Said as a Bash permission dialog opens, before the command's description. Empty: silence both the notice and the description.
noticeCommand.default: コマンドの確認をお願いします。

noticeTool.title: Notice: tool
noticeTool.description: Said as any other tool's permission dialog opens. Empty: say nothing.
noticeTool.default: ツールの許可をお願いします。

noticeCut.title: Notice: cut
noticeCut.description: Said where a response passes Max characters per response and the rest is skipped. Empty: say nothing.
